lignes.texte: Traveling with friends? The dream. Planning it together… not so much.
Tripora. Group travel, from first idea to lasting memory.
One wish, one sentence: your trip is ready. No account needed.
Invite the crew. Everyone adds their own wishes and budget.
Tripora compares destinations — flights, weather, total cost — and explains every pick.
The group votes. You choose the destination together.
Swipe through activities. The group ranking builds itself.
A day-by-day itinerary, with real places. Rain on Thursday? Tripora suggests a swap.
Saw it online? Share it. It’s pinned.
Bookings, tickets, codes: the whole group has everything. Even offline.
A receipt? Snap it. The expense is logged and split.
Who owes what? Settled in two transfers.
All your photos, in one shared journal.
Back home, a recap to share — and a passport that fills up with every trip.
And this is just the beginning.
